description: Catalog-guided audio, GIF, font, and sprite selection plus safe runtime integration rules extracted from the clone world/media material.

skills.title: Use workspace catalogs as the authority
skills.intent: Make media selection deterministic and approved rather than ad hoc.
required_actions: Use approved local catalogs for audio, GIFs, fonts, and sprite/media-backed selections when applicable.
Infer closest semantic matches instead of inventing unrelated assets.
Keep catalog-backed choices aligned with the authored world and gameplay meaning.
acceptance_bar: Media choices are traceable to approved catalogs.
No important selection depends on random external discovery.
failure_modes_prevented: Media identity detached from the remix premise

skills.title: Enrich media without flattening stronger authored work
skills.intent: Prevent the media layer from downgrading world or visual work into cheaper mapped assets.
required_actions: Preserve stronger authored backgrounds and scene systems created by earlier phases.
Prefer like-for-like replacements within the same asset lane.
Do not let a mapped asset restore stock-scene ownership.
acceptance_bar: Media mapping strengthens the remix without overwriting stronger visual systems.
failure_modes_prevented: Catalog assets overriding better procedural art

skills.title: Inventory current assets and decide keep/replace/remap
skills.intent: Preserve the world-design/media-mapping discipline of classifying current asset usage rather than jumping directly to replacements.
required_actions: Inventory current images, audio, CSS background images, sprite references, inline drawing opportunities, and brittle external URLs.
Decide for each item whether to keep, replace, recolor, rename/reframe, remove, preserve as fallback, or repair.
Avoid blind deletion and avoid leaving broken references behind.
acceptance_bar: Media changes are traceable to explicit role decisions.
The media layer remains understandable and auditable.
failure_modes_prevented: Deleting assets without understanding their role
Broken references surviving because inventory never happened

skills.title: Choose structurally feasible media targets
skills.intent: Map media into places the current runtime can actually support without destabilization.
required_actions: Prefer feedback moments, UI layers, titles, headings, and clearly compatible injection points.
Use existing hooks first instead of inventing broad new systems.
Leave partial enrichment rather than force unsafe plumbing.
acceptance_bar: Media integration points are practical and maintainable.
The game does not become fragile just to satisfy richness goals.
failure_modes_prevented: Broad new subsystems for tiny audiovisual gains
Media targets chosen only for novelty rather than fit

skills.title: Aim for a strong safe subset of audio, GIF, and font integration
skills.intent: Define a practical media richness floor without destabilizing gameplay.
required_actions: Integrate meaningful SFX when safe.
Use lightweight GIFs for feedback states only.
Import and visibly apply at least a primary and secondary font when catalog-backed font use is applicable.
acceptance_bar: Media choices are visibly used rather than merely declared.
failure_modes_prevented: Aspirational media mapping with no real wiring
Decorative clutter instead of feedback value
Font imports with no actual application

skills.title: Use tiny, failure-tolerant integration patterns
skills.intent: Keep audio/GIF integration lightweight and non-blocking.
required_actions: Use small plain-JS helpers and user-gesture-safe audio lifecycles.
Ensure failures are silent and do not break play.
Keep overlays ephemeral and away from control zones.
acceptance_bar: Media failures do not break the game.
Integrated media remains easy to repair and reason about.

skills.title: Resolve flagged candidates deterministically
skills.intent: Treat flagged media weaknesses as actual required work when the workflow surfaces them.
required_actions: Replace flagged weak or disallowed candidates with the closest approved semantic match.
Do not ignore unresolved media diagnostics when they are actionable.
Keep replacement logic bounded and explainable.
acceptance_bar: Known actionable media weaknesses are resolved or explicitly blocked.

skills.title: Keep media compact on mobile
skills.intent: Protect HUD clarity, controls, and next-step actions while adding audiovisual polish.
required_actions: Avoid persistent playfield blockers.
Keep overlays small, feedback-oriented, and non-critical.
Favor readability and actionability over ornamental density.
acceptance_bar: Media integration does not crowd essential UI or control zones.
